summary: First-pass test of NAF 19-Point Inspection app. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (100%) covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate/no-token), inspection CRUD, status_general auto-computation (bueno/malo), ownership-based 404, list sort desc, and offline client_uuid dedup. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login with test@naf.com/123456 lands on /inicio with bottom tabs (Inicio/Histórico/Nueva/Perfil). Inicio shows stats and today's list. Nueva wizard step 1 (5 fields with testIDs) and step 2 (all 19 points, Bueno/Malo toggles, Malo expands comments textarea) verified. Histórico lists inspections, search input and Todos/Bueno/Con falla filter chips all work; detail view /inspection/[id] renders status banner + Datos Generales + 19 puntos read-only.
action_items: Optional: add a testID like 'signature-open-button' on the firma button in step 4 of Nueva, and 'guardar-inspeccion-button' on the final submit, to make end-to-end Playwright testing of signature+save flow deterministic (currently not blocking; backend POST /api/inspections was independently verified end-to-end).
Optional: silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning from a child component (cosmetic React Native Web warning, not breaking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean (~250 lines), uses async motor, excludes Mongo _id, hashes with bcrypt, JWT with 30-day expiry, proper 400/401/404 codes, Pydantic validation.
Offline dedup via client_uuid implemented and verified — idempotent POST returns the same inspection id on retry.
Ownership check on GET /api/inspections/{id} confirmed (other user gets 404).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all reachable flows verified; step 4 signature + GUARDAR submit not exercised end-to-end via UI, but backend create endpoint is independently verified)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed inspections under test@naf.com via pytest (TEST_Transportes SA / ABC-1234, TEST_Mala SA / XYZ-9999, TEST_Dedup / DUP-111) and one TEST_Empresa UI partial via the wizard (not saved because step2 requires all 19 toggles).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is fully working. Mongo collections used: users, inspections. test@naf.com/123456 exists. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_naf_inspections.py is reusable. The Nueva wizard step-2 'Siguiente' button is intentionally disabled until ALL 19 points are evaluated — when scripting in Playwright you must click 19 Bueno (or Malo) toggles before proceeding to step 3/4. To test signature canvas on web, react-native-signature-canvas mounts inside an iframe/webview; consider mocking inspector_firma directly via the app store or testing only that the signature modal opens.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
